αἱ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl. ’they’, referring to the ships (αἱ δ’ ... ἔπλεον) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of women (αἱ δ’ ὅτε ... ἵκοντο ’and when they came’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the mules (αἱ δ’ ὦκα λίπον ’and they quickly left’)
αἶσα: αἶσα — portion, lot, destiny; fem. nom. sg., used impersonally with an inf.: ’it is not his lot to…’ · also plain subject: ’portion, lot’ (ἅσσα οἱ αἶσα … νήσαντο ’whatever his portion … spun for him’)
αἶψ: αἶψα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (αἶψ’ = αἶψα)
αὐδήν: αὐδή — voice, human speech; fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in voice’ · also as the direct object of a verb of hearing (θεοῦ ἔκλυεν αὐδήν ’heard the voice of the god’)
αὐτούς: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. pl.: ’them’ · also intensive, ’the very men themselves’ (with a following τε … τε)
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg.: ’she herself’, ’you yourself’
αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for herself’ · also plain anaphoric pronoun referring to a thing, dat. sg. with ἐν: ’in it’ (ἐν αὐτῇ, of the ship) · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοί περ αὐτῇ, μοι αὐτῇ ’for me myself’) · also reinforcing a 2nd-person pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σοὶ ὧδ’ αὐτῇ ’for you yourself’) · also dat. sg. of a thing, no ἐν, ’against it’ or ’against her’, with ποτικέκλιται (referent uncertain: pillar or queen) · also plain pronoun, dat. sg. with μίσγεται: ’with her’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῇ μίσγεται ’nor does anyone consort with her’)
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. (ὣς δ’ αὔτως ’and in just the same way’) · also ’simply, without more’, of words alone (ἦ αὔτως ἐπέεσσιν ’or simply with words’)
βάλλον: βάλλω — throw, cast; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβαλλον): ’were casting, threw’
βορέην: Βορέας — the North Wind, personified; epic acc. sg. Βορέην
βορέης: Βορέας — the North Wind, personified; epic nom. sg. Βορέης (= Attic Βορέας)
βούλοντο: βούλομαι — wish, will, be minded; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐβούλοντο): ’they wished’
βοῦς: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; acc. pl. · also masc./fem. nom. sg. (same spelling as the acc. pl.): ’the ox, the heifer’ (ἦλθε ... βοῦς ’the heifer came’)
βῆμεν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἔβημεν): ’we went, we embarked’
γέ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle, accented γέ before a following enclitic
γίγνεται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen, arise; pres. 3 sg. (χρεὼ γίγνεται ’a need arises’)
γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)
γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλαφυροῖσι: γλαφυρός — hollow; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δαιτυμόνες: δαιτυμών — guest at a feast, feaster; masc. nom. pl.
δειλῶν: δειλός — wretched, miserable, worthless; masc. gen. pl.: ’(for) the worthless’
δεκάτῃ: δέκατος — tenth; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with νυκτί: ’on the tenth (night)’
δεπάεσσι: δέπας — cup, goblet; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic δέπασι)
δεῖπνον: δεῖπνον — meal, supper; neut. acc. sg. (περὶ δεῖπνον ’about the meal’)
δολόεσσα: δολόεις — crafty, guileful; adj., fem. nom. sg., epic -όεσσα
δόσαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔδοσαν)
δύναμαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 sg.
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable
δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κλυτὰ δώματ’ ἔασιν ’his famous halls are’
δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.
δῖα: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. nom. sg., epithet of goddesses and heroes
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’
εἰλίποδας: εἰλίπους — rolling-gaited, swaying-footed (of cattle); masc./fem. acc. pl.
εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν before a vowel) — in, on; + dat.
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’)
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζόφον: ζόφος — gloom, darkness (esp. of the west, where the sun sets); masc. acc. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle
θανάτοιο: θάνατος — death; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θεάων: θεά — goddess; gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῶν)
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεσπεσίῃ: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, prodigious, superhuman in scale; fem. dat. sg. (ἠχῇ θεσπεσίῃ ’with a wondrous outcry’)
θοῇσι: θοός — swift; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θῖνα: θίς — shore, beach; fem. acc. sg.
κάλλιστον: καλός — beautiful, fine; superl. κάλλιστος, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’fairest, finest’
κάλυψε: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκάλυψε)
κάτα: κατά — down, throughout; prep. + acc., placed after its noun with anastrophe: κραναὴν Ἰθάκην κάτα ’throughout rocky Ithaca’
κήδε: κῆδος — care, sorrow, trouble; neut. acc. pl., elided (κήδε’ = κήδεα, uncontracted; Attic κήδη)
κήδεα: κῆδος — care, trouble, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήδη)
κίον: κίω — go, move; epic impf. 3 pl. (= ἐπορεύοντο), unaugmented
κίρκη: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. nom. sg.
καθῖζον: καθίζω — sit down, take one’s seat; impf. 3 pl.
κακὴ: κακός — bad, harmful; adj., fem. nom. sg.
καλυψώ: Καλυψώ — Calypso, a nymph; fem. nom. sg.
καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with a noun) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (with an infinitive) · also neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’a fine one’ (μάλα καλὸν ἑλών) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive, agreeing with a stated neut. noun: ’fine’ (καλὸν δέπας ’the fine cup’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’fair, fine’ (ὕδωρ καλὸν ’fair water’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial or cognate with a finite verb: οὐ καλὸν ἔειπες ’you have not spoken well’
καμάτῳ: κάματος — toil, weariness; masc. dat. sg.
καρπόν: καρπός — fruit, grain; masc. acc. sg., object of ἀλετρεύουσι: ’grain’
καταλέξω: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order; fut. 1 sg. or aor. subj. 1 sg. (the epic forms coincide): ’I will tell in full’
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’
κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead) · also subj. (= κέηται): ’should lie’ · also plain pres. 3 sg. of stored objects: ’lies, is kept/stored’ (κειμήλια κεῖται ’treasures lie stored’) · also pres. 3 sg. of a living person in a settled, ongoing state, not of the dead nor of an outcome nor of stored goods (ὁ μὲν ἐν νήσῳ κεῖται ’πάσχων’): ’remains, is stranded, dwells on’ · also of a place, ’lies, is situated’ (νῆσος ... κεῖται ’an island lies’)
κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown, report; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), direct object: μέγα κλέος ἤρατο ’won great fame’; κλέος φέρειν ’bring report’
κληῖσι: κληΐς — thole-pin, oarlock (also ’key, bolt’ elsewhere); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισι
κρίνας: κρίνω — pick out, choose, judge; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having picked out’
κρειῶν: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. gen. pl., epic κρειῶν with ει for ε (= Attic κρεῶν)
κρεῖον: κρείων — ruler, lord, ruling; masc. voc. sg., a title of address
κτήματα: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. nom./acc. pl.
κῦμα: κῦμα — wave; nom. sg. · also acc. sg. (identical neut. form), object of a preposition (κατὰ κῦμα ’over the wave’) · also acc. sg., direct object: μέγα κῦμα ’a great wave’
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl., governed by ἄνασσε ’was lord over’ · also gen. with a noun: ’of the people’ (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’) · also governed by ἐκ: ἔκ ... λαῶν ’from the people’ · also partitive gen. after a relative: οἵ ... λαῶν ἡμετέρων ’those of our people who’ · also partitive gen. after an adjective of rank: πάντων ἀριδείκετε λαῶν ’most distinguished of all the people’ · also gen. governed by πρόσθεν: ’before (the city and) the people’
λεύκ: λευκός — white; neut. nom. pl., elided (λεύκ’ = λευκά)
λιλαιομένη: λιλαίομαι — long for, yearn (+ inf.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’)
μένομεν: μένω — remain, wait, stay; pres./impf. 1 pl. (the form itself does not distinguish tense), with past force in narration: ’we waited’
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
μελιηδέα: μελιηδής — honey-sweet; fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (adj. of two endings)
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’)
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μυθήσομαι: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak of; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall tell’
μόρον: μόρος — portion, fate, allotted share; acc. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
μῆλα: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. nom. pl.: ’the flocks’ · also neut. acc. pl. (same form), direct object: ἦγον ... μῆλα ’they led sheep’
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
νήπιοι: νήπιος — childish, foolish, witless; masc. nom. pl.
ναίων: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’dwelling’
νεφέεσσι: νέφος — cloud; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
νηλεὲς: νηλεής — pitiless, ruthless; neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic νηλές); cf. dat. νηλέι
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
νόστοιο: νόστος — return home; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), + gen. with τυγχάνω
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νύκτας: νύξ — night; fem. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’by nights’
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
νῆες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl., epic νῆες
ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household (and its stores); acc. sg.
οἷος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg. · rough-breathed οἷος is relative ’such as, of the kind that’ (οἷος Ὀδυσσεὺς ἔσκεν ’such as Odysseus was’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐδὲν: οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν — no one, nothing; neut. acc./nom. sg. used adverbially: ’not at all’
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
οὐρανίωνες: Οὐρανίων — child of Uranus (Heaven) or dweller in heaven, sense disputed; masc. nom. pl., epic: θεοὶ Οὐρανίωνες ’the gods, the children of Heaven’
οὐρανόθεν: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; adv. οὐρανόθεν, -θεν ’from’: ’from the sky’
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πίονα: πίων — fat, rich; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with νῶτα: ’fat’
παρέστη: παρίστημι — stand beside, take one’s stand by; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
πατρίδος: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; gen. sg.
πεδίῳ: πεδίον — plain, flat land; neut. dat. sg.
πεζὸν: πεζός — on foot; masc. acc. sg., predicative with the subject of an infinitive
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
πλέομεν: πλέω — sail; pres. 1 pl., vivid narrative present for a past situation: ‘we were sailing’
πλέονες: πολύς — much, many; comparative πλέων/πλείων, masc. nom. pl. πλέονες: ’the greater number, most’
πολιὴν: πολιός — grey, hoary; adj., fem. acc. sg. (πολιὴν ἅλα ’the grey sea’)
πολλαὶ: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’)
πολλὸν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’much’
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, formerly; enclitic adv.
ποτῆτος: ποτής — drink, drinking; fem. gen. sg.
πρίν: πρίν — before, until; conj./adv., + inf. (like Attic πρίν) · also + a temporal clause (πρίν γ’ ὅτ’ ἄν + subj.): ’until the time when’ · also πρίν κε + opt., an independent potential clause answering a suppressed protasis: ’sooner, before then’ (πρίν κεν ... ἵκοιο ’you would arrive home before then’) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article, no inf.: ’formerly, at first’ (parallel to the by-form πρὶν)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προτέρω: πρότερος — before, further; neut. comp. adv. προτέρω: ’further in’
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πόλιος: πόλις — city; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic πόλεως)
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; acc. sg.
πόσιν: πόσις — husband; acc. sg. · also the distinct noun πόσις ’a drinking, drink’ (from πίνω); acc. sg.: ’drink’ (paired with βρῶσις ’eating’)
πώς: πώς (= enclitic πως) — somehow, in any way; accented πώς because followed by a further enclitic (με): ’lest he somehow...’
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σίτου: σῖτος — bread, grain, food; masc. gen. sg.
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
σπέσσι: σπέος — cave; neut. dat. pl. (plural for a single cave), epic -εσσι
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
στεναχίζω: στεναχίζω — groan, wail; pres. 1 sg., epic
σφι: σφι — epic dat. pl. pron. ’to/for them’ (= Attic αὐτοῖς)
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by (+ gen.); adv.
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’
σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’)
τέλεσ: τελέω — bring to an end, complete; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (τέλεσ’ = τέλεσε)
τέλος: τέλος — end, completion, fulfilment; neut. nom./acc. sg.
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τινες: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. nom. pl. (after a relative, οἵ τινες = ὅστις pl.): ’whoever’ · also indefinite ’any’ after a negative: οὔ τινες ’not any, none’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιοῦδ: τοιόσδε — such as this; masc. gen. sg., elided (τοιοῦδ’ = τοιοῦδε)
τοκήων: τοκεύς — parent, begetter; masc. gen. pl.
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’)
τοῦτό: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg., accented before enclitic γ’
τρίτον: τρίτος — third; ordinal numeral, neut. nom. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: τρίτον ἄνδρα ’a third man’ (as direct object) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: τρίτον ἦμαρ ’the third day’ (τέλεσ’ Ἠώς ’Dawn completed the third day’)
τροίηθεν: Τροίη — Troy; adv. form with ablatival suffix -θεν: ‘from Troy’
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ἕως ’until’
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’)
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ‘them, those’ (referring to ships) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the mules
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλους: φίλος — dear, one’s own; substantival masc. acc. pl.: ’dear ones, kin’
φερόμην: φέρω — carry; impf. pass. 1 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐφερόμην): ’I was carried, I drifted’
φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, it is right; impersonal verb + acc. and inf. · also + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need of’
ἀκουέμεν: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀκούειν)
ἀλκίνοε: Ἀλκίνοος — Alcinous, king of the Phaeacians; masc. voc. sg.
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.
ἀλλήλῃσι: ἀλλήλων — one another; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἀλλήλαις)
ἀμφιέλισσαι: ἀμφιέλισσα — curved on both sides (or rowed both ways); sense uncertain; fem. nom. pl., epithet of ships
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀνά: ἀνά — up, up along; prep. + acc., or adv. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνά … ἔβαινον = ἀνέβαινον ’mounted’); acute kept before an enclitic
ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες)
ἀνδράσι: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic ἀνδράσι
ἀνθρώποισι: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’)
ἀοιδοῦ: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. gen. sg.
ἀπάνευθε: ἀπάνευθε — far away, apart, at a distance; adv., + gen.
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπόπροθι: ἀπόπροθι — far off, at a distance; adv.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀρείους: ἀγαθός — good; irregular comparative ἀρείων, masc. nom. pl. ἀρείους, + gen. of comparison: ’better than’
ἀριδείκετε: ἀριδείκετος — very conspicuous, distinguished (ἀρι- intensifying; the second part is obscure); masc. voc. sg.
ἀριπρεπές: ἀριπρεπής — very conspicuous, splendid, eminent; neut. nom. sg.
ἀσκηθὴς: ἀσκηθής — unharmed, unscathed; masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἁλὶ: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. dat. sg.
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’
ἄγον: ἄγω — lead, bring, take along; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγον): ’I took along’
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλγεσι: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. dat. pl.
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄνδρε: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. dual: ’two men’
ἄνευθε: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart from, without; prep. + gen., epic (= Attic ἄνευ)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἅλα: ἅλς — sea, salt sea; fem. acc. sg.
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅπαντα: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl., subject or object of a verb: ’all things’ (τελευτηθῆναι ἅπαντα ’that all things were fulfilled’)
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμὰ: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναλίγκιος: ἐναλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg.
ἐννῆμαρ: ἐννῆμαρ — for nine days; adv. (ἐννέα + ἦμαρ)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
ἐπίθοντο: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey; aor. mid. 3 pl., augmented (unaugmented πίθοντο): ’they obeyed’
ἐπιβαινέμεν: ἐπιβαίνω — go upon, embark on, board; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐπιβαίνειν), + gen.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’)
ἐπῶρσ: ἐπόρνυμι — rouse, stir up (against); aor. 3 sg., augmented, elided (ἐπῶρσ’ = ἐπῶρσε): ’roused (against them)’
ἐρετμοῖς: ἐρετμόν — oar; neut. dat. pl., instrumental: ’with oars’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐυδείελον: ἐυδείελος — stock epithet of Ithaca, exact sense disputed (perhaps ’clear-seen’); fem. acc. sg.
ἐυκνήμιδες: ἐυκνήμις — well-greaved (wearing greaves on the shins); masc. nom. pl., epithet applied here to Telemachus’s own crew
ἐυπλόκαμος: ἐϋπλόκαμος — fair-tressed, with fine hair; fem. nom. sg. (Calypso’s standing epithet) · also used of Demeter (5.125), so not unique to Calypso despite the parenthetical above
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα)
ἐόντας: εἰμί — be; pres. part. acc. pl. masc., epic (= Attic ὄντας)
ἑζόμενοι: ἕζομαι — sit down; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’seated’
ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
ἑξῆς: ἑξῆς — in order, one after another; adv. (by-form of ἑξείης)
ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἑτάρους: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); acc. pl.
ἑτάρων: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. gen. pl. (= Attic ἑταίρων)
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔδοντες: ἔδω — eat (epic, = Attic ἐσθίω); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’eating’
ἔδουσιν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι)
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, with suffix -θεν
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔρυκε: ἐρύκω — hold back, detain, keep; impf. 3 sg., no augment · also pres. imper. 2 sg., in a prohibition with μή: μὴ ... ἔρυκε ’do not detain (me)!’
ἔχῃ: ἔχω — hold, have, keep to; pres. subj. 3 sg.
ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.
ἕλικας: ἕλιξ — twisted, curved (of cattle’s horns); fem. acc. pl.
ἕλοντο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἵλοντο): ’took (for themselves)’
ἠπείρου: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; gen. sg.
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἠῶ: ἠώς (Attic ἕως) — dawn; acc. sg., accusative of extent: ’on into the dawn’
ἡμέας: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; acc. pl., epic ἡμέας (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’
ἤθελεν: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 sg., augmented, + inf.: ’he wished’
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἤπειρόνδε: ἤπειρος — mainland; fem. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ’to the mainland’
ἥμενοι: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I have come’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj.
ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whose, of whom/which (fem. gen. sg.)
ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to see’
ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg.
ἰχθυόεντα: ἰχθυόεις — fish-filled, teeming with fish; neut. acc. pl. (ἰχθυόεντα κέλευθα ’fish-filled paths’, of the sea) · also masc. acc. sg. w/ πόντον: ’upon the fish-teeming sea’, not only neut. acc. pl. of κέλευθα
ἰόντι: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’for you, going’
ἱερὸν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος: ἱερὸν μένος ’sacred might’
ἱκόμην: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. mid. 1 sg., unaugmented: ’I came’
ἱστοὺς: ἱστός — mast; masc. acc. pl. · also loom, web: ἱστοὺς ὑφόωσι ’weave at the looms’
ἲς: ἴς (gen. ἰνός) — force, strength, might; fem. nom. sg., in the periphrasis ἱερὴ ἲς + gen. ’the sacred strength of ...’, i.e. the hero himself
ἵκει: ἵκω — come upon, reach, arrive at; pres. 3 sg., epic beside ἱκνέομαι
ἵν: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj., elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα) · also relative adverb of place, ’where’ (= Attic οὗ): τῶν ἐνὶ δήμῳ, ἵν’ οἴχεται ’among those of the land where he has gone’
ὀδυρόμενος: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀρώρει: ὄρνυμι — rouse; (intrans.) arise, spring up; pluperf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had sprung up’
ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
ὄρος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. acc. sg., object of ἷξε: ‘the mountain’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’
ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά · also plain relative pron., masc. acc. sg., not accented for a following enclitic: ’whom’ (ὅν ῥα καθεῖσεν ’whom he had stationed’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’
ὅσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl.: ’all that, as much as’
ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’) · also + opt., in a repeated past clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂψ ἄρχοιτο ’whenever he began again’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’)
ὑμῖν: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; dat. pl.: ’to you’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, in; postpositive prep. + dat., anastrophe (ὕπνῳ ὕπο = ὑπὸ ὕπνῳ): ’in (sweet sleep)’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὥρῃ: ὥρα — season, time; fem. dat. sg.
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
